           EUPATORIUM AROMATICUM

         Pool-root


Nervous erethism; restlessness and morbid watchfulness. Hysteria and
        chorea. Low fevers, with extreme restlessness.


Aphthous disease.   Sore nipples  . Sore
        mouth in infants. Vomiting of bile, pain in stomach, headache, and fever.



Relationship.--    Lapsana communis  -Nipple-wort-useful
        in sore nipples and piles.   Hyosc; Passiflor; Hydr mur  .



Dose.--  Tincture, locally, in sore mouth and sore nipples.
        Internally, tincture to third attenuation.
